rulings: Phase B is claimed, but its precondition is met through a new catalog, not by editing the U06 table: MethodFacts carries the request extension and the RODAS5P catalog entry carries six exact route variants (banded-fast and sequential-dense included). MethodRequest, descriptors() and query() are unchanged because tests/geometry_mol_contracts.rs (outside the allowlist) uses the MethodRequest struct literal and U06 tests r1/r5 pin the six entries. query() therefore still disagrees with select in the COD-03 cases; routing goes through route().
GeneralOde::select keeps its receipt (implicit_route) on the facade capability query, so default routing is unchanged; plans of route() name the driver that actually runs.
No existing test was edited. PeerSolution keeps failure: Option<String> (now the display text of the typed reason) and gains reason and starter, so unified_method_sessions.rs passes as is.

Integrator-crate adapters accept only the provider forms their driver problem takes natively (BDF, Radau: Dense and Jvp; PEXPRB: Jvp and autonomous; lagged: Dense); everything else is a typed refusal.
Auto fallback restarts at t0 with the next admitted candidate and reuses no state of the failed attempt; measured evidence is used only as caller-supplied CostEvidence.
PeerOde starter control follows PREDECLARED.json: step doubling at the five non-initial nodes, accept at estimate <= 1, halve h0, at most 40 halvings.
The U06 radau-iia3 descriptor said 2 stages / order 3; corrected to 3 stages / order 5 to match radau.rs.
One launch of the full suite was stopped by me while still compiling, before any test ran, to add the route-variant table; its partial log was removed. No test result was discarded.
open_issues: Owner decision needed: for a general (non-banded) sparse-JVP provider Rodas5p::capabilities answers MatrixFree, but Rodas5p::solve runs the fast dense driver (dense output) or the dense fast driver (vector atol) on a Jacobian built from n JVP columns. Not fixed (capabilities.rs and the RODAS5P path of solve.rs are outside this node). On the default path GeneralOde::select therefore does not apply max_dense_dimension for such a problem with a vector atol; the old body decides the same.
Reviewer should judge whether Phase B is accepted as implemented: the legacy MethodRegistry::query(&MethodRequest) still disagrees with select in the COD-03 cases.

BDF, Radau, PEXPRB and lagged drivers return no last accepted state on failure and no record after a fatal callback error; the view then holds only the reached output samples (t0) and callback-boundary counts. A better prefix needs edits in rodas5p-integrators.
PeerOde now charges two extra starter solves per run and may halve h0; PPSW1 startup counters of U11/V10 change (trajectories were bit-identical in the four U07 cases).

API changes to check at merge with the concurrent unified-router group: RegistryRefusal gained ProviderFormUnsupported; many new public names are re-exported at the crate root (Method*, JacobianForm, SolutionView, Peer*).
GeneralOde::select now builds the catalog on every call (small heap allocations; no callback, no numerical workspace).
Auto and fallback have contract tests only; no performance evidence. A caller-requested output grid is not implemented.
A declared band on a dense provider is verified by the protected router with callbacks; that refusal (SolveError::StructureRefused) is a solve-time error of the direct call, not a routing refusal.
Still not reachable from the facade: ppsw1-6b-matrix-free-common-w (no end-to-end driver or matrix-free starter), small/batch RODAS5P, SABR, homotopy, transactional q1/q2, PTSW2B, vigilode-coupled.

review.summary: Accept with corrections. Scope, protection and commit order are clean (28 paths inside the allowlist, protected diff empty, PREDECLARED 00d32764 before the first log, loop checker PASS). All four frozen discriminators reproduce: 31 contract tests with every QUAL record byte-equal to the builder's log, golden oracle twice (9 files identical, equal to base blobs), full suite 497/0; receipt and report regenerate from the committed logs. Independent checks: failing-first rerun on a scratch copy of base (8 fail, 1 pass, same records); 300000 random fact combinations give select == select_reference with 0 callbacks; 37/37 adapter cases on other fixtures are bitwise equal; Auto used no capability outside the allowed set in 25328 executed attempts. Corrections: (1) major: the claim that RODAS5P plans equal the driver that runs (18432/18432) is a model comparison; 352 distinct grid plans (general sparse-JVP on the sequential route) cannot run; (2) PPSW1 ignores an invalid Options::h0; (3) a false band declaration is refused after 2 callbacks; (4) an edited plan runs without re-admission; (5) PeerOde runs change beyond startup counters; (6) label fixes.
